pitfalls.title: Pitfall Log
pitfalls.subtitle: Problems found in the system and in AI behaviour. Shared by everyone, because these patterns only show up when you look across all members
pitfalls.kind.unobserved: An iron rule was touched but the server kept no record
pitfalls.kind.unverified: The system saw it, but the AI did not report it
pitfalls.kind.orphan_session: A whole conversation with no compliance record
pitfalls.kind_hint.unobserved: A system-level problem. Most of these are historical data left by older versions; the "what to do" line on each row says whether to act
pitfalls.kind_hint.unverified: An AI behaviour problem: the system observed the rule being triggered, but the AI did not record that it complied
pitfalls.kind_hint.orphan_session: A conversation of five turns or more with no compliance record at all
pitfalls.none_in_window: No records of this kind in this period
pitfalls.all_clear: No problems found in this period
periodic.title: Weekly & monthly reports
periodic.subtitle: Your week or month on one page: how many memories you added, and what the system distilled from your session notes.
periodic.card.created_note: The two figures below count what was created during this period. The job runs early on Monday over the previous week, so items distilled from last week's friction are counted in this one.
periodic.list.empty_compressed_only: The session records for this period have passed the retention window and were compressed into a monthly summary; the original notes are no longer kept. Nothing is shown here because the detail was discarded, not because none was written.
periodic.list.empty_no_sessions: No session was recorded in this period, so there was nothing to distil. This does not mean you hit no friction — it means there is no data.
periodic.list.empty_no_details: {total} sessions were recorded in this period, but none carried the reflection fields, so nothing could be distilled. That is a reporting gap, not a smooth period.
periodic.list.empty_measured_empty: Looked through the {analyzed} sessions recorded in this period and none mentioned any. This is a genuine none.
periodic.list.empty_unknown: The server did not send enough to tell whether this is "none" or "not reported".
periodic.retention.whole: This period is older than the 90-day session-detail retention window. Records past that age are compressed into a monthly summary and the originals are not kept, so both lists below are not guaranteed to be complete.
periodic.retention.partial: Part of this period is older than the 90-day session-detail retention window. Those days may already have been compressed away, so both lists below are not guaranteed to cover the whole period.
